7.3.4 Consecutive Frames
[SWS_FrArTp_00058] ⌈If no error occurred, an FF-x is followed by Consecutive
Frames until the whole message is transmitted.⌋
Not compliant to ISO 15765-2
[SWS_FrArTp_00059] ⌈If configured for the specific channel, a Consecutive Frame
can also appear in a 1:n connection.⌋
[SWS_FrArTp_00239] ⌈The PCI of a Consecutive Frame consists of one byte, which
is divided in two 4-bit parts.⌋
Consecutive Frames consist of one byte PCI and the payload as depicted in the Table
